title: thymus serpyllum subsp. bracteatus
intro: Thymus serpyllum subsp. bracteatus, commonly known as creeping thyme, is a low-growing, spreading perennial herb native to Europe. This plant is prized for its tiny leaves and pink or purple flowers, and it is widely used for culinary and medicinal purposes. The health benefits of creeping thyme include its antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe sore throats and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of creeping thyme are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including thymol, carvacrol, and rosmarinic acid, which exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, making it useful for treating various health conditions.
